# Trigger catalogue — sprezzature-cli-gui

**Generated by `scripts/build_triggers.py`. Do not hand-edit.** A test asserts this file equals the generated output, so a phrase added here and nowhere else fails CI.

Wraps an argparse / Click / any-CLI in a single-page HTML GUI (three adapters).

## When this skill is the answer

**You are holding:** A command-line tool somebody who will not type it needs to run.

A phrase list cannot generalise — the ways to ask are unbounded, and a user almost never names the tool. What is bounded is the kind of thing in front of them. Match that first; the phrases below confirm a match, they do not make one.

Said without naming a tool: "my colleague keeps getting the flags wrong", "can non-technical people use this", « une interface pour l'équipe »

## When it is not

Not this one when: the screen has no CLI behind it (sprezzature-ui, whose stack rules this follows; install it alongside for the full design tokens). The exhaustive trigger catalogue is in `references/triggers.md`.

- `wrap this CLI in a GUI`
- `build a UI for my CLI`
- `argparse to GUI`
- `click to web UI`
- `GUI for my Python script`
- `wrap my command-line tool`
- `web form for my script`
- `Typer / clap / cobra to GUI`
